empty.title: Start with your first project
empty.body: A name is all you need. Contract value, costs and billing can come later.

job.title: Start with your first job
job.body: Short or daily work. A name is enough - costs and billing can come later.

workOrder.title: Start with your first service call
workOrder.body: Capture the customer and what needs fixing. Scheduling and costs can come later.

missingData.modalDescription: Below is what is missing for accurate calculations, and what is worth reviewing for a complete business picture. Each item links to where you can fix it.
missingData.kpiUnavailableContractHint: No contract or price basis yet for open-price work.
missingData.kpiUnavailableProfitHint: Profit and margin need a revenue basis — not shown as zero.

workforce_entries_missing_cost.title: Missing cost on time entries
workforce_entries_missing_cost.description: Some time entries have no employer cost or labor rate.
workforce_entries_missing_cost.why: Without labor cost, actual cost and profitability may be understated.

unallocated_remainder.title: Unallocated business costs
unallocated_remainder.description: Approved organization expenses are not yet allocated to projects.
unallocated_remainder.why: These costs stay outside project actual — project totals may be partial.

open_draft_documents.title: Drafts not in actual cost
open_draft_documents.description: Draft expenses or purchase orders are not finalized yet.
open_draft_documents.why: Until finalized they are not in actual cost — totals may look lower than expected.

open_allocations.title: Allocations not applied
open_allocations.description: Allocation runs or overhead allocations are still open.
open_allocations.why: Costs reach projects only after apply — until then they stay outside project actual.

foreign_currency_excluded.title: Projects in another currency
foreign_currency_excluded.description: Some projects use a currency different from the organization base.
foreign_currency_excluded.why: Those amounts are excluded from this business summary — only base currency is totaled here.

open_price_contract_basis.title: Missing contract or price basis
open_price_contract_basis.description: All active work is open-price — no contract value or price set yet.
open_price_contract_basis.why: Without revenue basis, contract value, profit and margin cannot be calculated — zero is not a real business value.

serviceToday.title: Service today
serviceToday.body: Open Today for service and field items that need handling.
serviceToday.bodyService: Focus on today’s service calls and field follow-ups.

timeUtilization.title: Time & active work
timeUtilization.body: Time utilization metrics are not summarized here yet. Active work and attention counts stay honest until they are.

quotePipeline.title: Quotes
quotePipeline.body: Open the quotes list to review pipeline - no invented totals.

reports.title: Reports & analytics
reports.description: Organization visibility in the base currency. Every figure is labelled Actual, Committed, Forecast, Commercial, or Estimate. Profit uses net contract excluding VAT. Invoice totals are billing/cash, not profit.
reports.excludedForeign: {count, plural, =1 {# project excluded (other currency)} other {# projects excluded (other currency)}}
reports.truncatedRollup: {count, plural, =1 {# additional active project omitted from this display page (totals still include all eligible projects)} other {# additional active projects omitted from this display page (totals still include all eligible projects)}}

sections.commercialHint: Net contract value excluding VAT - not invoice total and not payment.
sections.cashHint: Invoice total and Paid are billing/cash amounts, including VAT if entered - not revenue for profit. Outstanding to collect is from open invoices. Forecast in/out uses due dates.
sections.costHint: Project Actual Cost net, allocated overhead, commitments, ETC and Forecast Final Cost net. Unallocated business costs are shown separately and are not forced into project profit.
sections.profitabilityHint: Actual profit net = current contract net - actual project cost net. Forecast profit net = current contract net - forecast final cost net. VAT and invoice totals stay out of project profit.
sections.operationsHint: Counts only - no notification delivery. Shown when you have permission and data.
sections.comparisonHint: Base-currency projects only. Committed is shown beside Actual, never added into it.
sections.managementHint: Owner metrics from recorded data only. Uncovered metrics stay hidden. No invented charts.

disclosures.baseCurrencyOnly: Amounts use organization base currency only.
disclosures.vatNotProfit: VAT is never treated as profit.
disclosures.projectPlusUnallocatedEqualsOrgExpense: Project-touching expense nets + unallocated organization costs = organization finalized expense total.
disclosures.unallocatedNotInProjectProfit: Unallocated business costs / costs awaiting allocation are not included in project Actual or project profit.

inclusions.primaryContractsBaseCurrency: Includes: primary contracts in base currency
inclusions.invoicedMinusPaid: Includes: invoice total minus paid (outstanding to collect)
inclusions.expensesAndLaborEntered: Includes: entered expenses and costed labor
inclusions.recognizedVendorBills: Includes: recognized posted vendor bills (Actual Vendor Cost)
inclusions.openPurchaseOrderCommitments: Includes: open / partially consumed PO commitments
inclusions.actualPlusEnteredRemaining: Includes: actual plus any entered remaining cost
inclusions.actualPlusRemainingCommitmentsPlusEtc: Includes: actual + remaining commitments + expected remaining (ETC)
inclusions.finalizedOrgCostsAwaitingAllocation: Includes: finalized organization costs awaiting allocation
inclusions.currentContractMinusEstimatedFinal: Includes: current contract net - forecast final cost net
inclusions.currentContractMinusActualCost: Includes: current contract net - actual project cost net
inclusions.plannedPastTargetDate: Includes: planned milestones past target date
inclusions.draftIssuedPartiallyReceived: Includes: draft, issued, partially received POs
inclusions.noDocumentAttached: Includes: artifacts without an attached document
inclusions.assetsWithProjectAssignment: Includes: assets assigned to a project

exclusions.recognizedVendorBills: Excludes: recognized vendor bills (already in Actual)
exclusions.vendorPayments: Excludes: vendor payments (cash only - not cost)
exclusions.entriesMissingRate: May understate when rates are missing
exclusions.incompleteCostCoverage: May be incomplete when cost sources are not configured
exclusions.unallocatedBusinessCosts: Excludes: unallocated business costs / costs awaiting allocation
exclusions.maintenanceCostAsExpense: Excludes: maintenance metadata amounts as Expense

cashFlow.title: Cash view - Actual vs Forecast
cashFlow.actualHint: Payments recorded with a payment date in this month-to-date range. Not a Forecast.
cashFlow.forecastHint: Outstanding billing by due date. Not Paid. Does not invent collection timing.
cashFlow.outgoingDisclosure: Outgoing cash is not forecast here: no open vendor bills with due dates are in scope. Expenses alone do not invent vendor invoices.
cashFlow.outgoingAvailableHint: Forecast from open vendor bills by due date - not Expense actual cost.
cashFlow.undatedNote: Amounts with no due date are listed under “No due date” and are not assigned to a Forecast week.
cashFlow.paymentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No payments in range} =1 {# payment} other {# payments}}

management.empty: No management metrics yet from the data entered so far.
management.utilizationUnavailable: Utilization % stays hidden until scheduled capacity is recorded.
